finding: A naive ProcessStableRuntime V4 that binds the new deterministic-replay authorization facade cannot be inserted only at RESERVE/recovery. The current forward provenance chain hard-codes the historical compliance runtime binding at both ADMIT and audit.

why.admit: Current top runtime calls contract.bind_admit(event, base._binding()), so every new contracted ADMIT stores the digest of the historical base runtime binding.
why.audit: Current runtime-provenance auditor computes expected_binding = historical base runtime _binding() and passes it to reservation_binding_status for every slot.
why.close: Current CLOSE/replay selects only its current runtime-provenance auditor binding or the historical auditor binding; a third replay-authorized runtime/auditor is not recognized.
why.consequence: If only RESERVE were changed to advertise a replay-authorized runtime binding, the existing auditor would mark the contracted slot runtime_provenance_fail:reserve_runtime_binding_mismatch. If ADMIT alone were changed, the existing auditor would reject the ADMIT contract because its expected binding is still the historical base.

safe_decision: Do not persist or activate the local V4 prototype as a runtime. Keep the new replay authorization facade role-local and non-default until the whole forward provenance chain is versioned together.
required_forward_only_upgrade: Define replay-authorized compliance runtime binding v2 that extends the frozen historical base binding with the replay-authorization facade blob.
Bind that v2 digest in new ADMITs before any score generation; historical ADMITs remain historical and are never reinterpreted.
Emit the exact same v2 binding in replay-authorized RESERVE events while preserving FAIL_CLOSED reservation behavior.
Add runtime-provenance auditor v2 that chooses the expected binding from the pre-score ADMIT contract version, not from a single hard-coded historical base.
Add superseding CLOSE/replay that recognizes the v2 auditor/binding and refuses downgrade to current/historical CLOSE for v2-contracted ADMITs.
Only then expose ProcessStableRuntime V4 replay APIs; default FAIL_CLOSED remains V3-compatible.
local_prototype_status: A local, unpersisted V4 API prototype passed isolated injected tests for bypass rejection, bound-request propagation, fresh-epoch recovery and historical replay rejection, but it intentionally was not written to the repository after the provenance-chain mismatch was identified.
scope_limitations: No claim that the new facade is integrated into the active V3 runtime.
No exact full-sibling byte execution in this run.
The finding is structural and based on frozen role-local source blobs; it does not require O, other workers, downstream state or legacy research.
